notes.title: Movement Gods v0.3.0
notes.content:
[h3]Update Overview: Movement Gods v0.3.0[/h3]  

[b]Map Changes:[/b]  
[list]  
[*]The "Box" map has been reworked.  
[*]A new training map has been added for testing game mechanics.  
[*]The "Arena" map has not been updated but has been adapted for the new sudden death mechanic.  
[/list]  

[b]New Features:[/b]  
[list]  
[*]Added a smoke grenade.  
[*]Sudden death: At the end of the round, lava rises to the ceiling, destroying everything, both [i]living[/i] and [i]non-living[/i].  
[*]The game now lasts until one player achieves three victories.  
[*]Climbing over objects is no longer animation-based but instead uses a physics-driven approach.  
[*]Wall jumps are now always available when near a wall, not just during wall-running.  
[/list]  

[b]Cosmetic Changes:[/b]  
[list]  
[*]Added a new climbing animation.  
[*]Updated jump start and mid-air animations.  
[*]All character sounds have been reworked.  
[*]Improved weapon visual effects.  
[*]Added a new menu theme music.  
[/list]  

[b]Balance:[/b]  
[list]  
[*]The economy has been reworked. It will be balanced in the next update, but testing is required.  
[/list]

notes.title: Movement Gods v0.2.2
notes.content: [h2]Patch Notes: Movement Gods v0.2.2[/h2][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][list]  [*]Fixed an issue where reloading would not function properly.[/*]  [*]Fixed a bug causing the interface to disappear after respawning.[/*]  [*]Improved performance in the main menu.[/*]  [*]Fixed a bug where players with high ping would not have their hits registered correctly.[/*]  [*]Fixed a bug where turret projectiles would not damage the turret owner.[/*]  [*]Fixed an issue where the turret could detect invisible players.[/*]  [*]Fixed a bug where taking damage did not break invisibility.[/*]  [*]Fixed an issue where turret explosions were not visible on the client side.[/*]  [*]Removed negative values in the displayed round time.[/*][/list][b]Balance Changes:[/b][list]  [*]Increased the sniper rifle’s shot speed from 60,000 to 80,000 and its damage to 55.[/*]  [*]Reduced the character impulse on death.[/*][/list][b]Cosmetic Changes:[/b][list]  [*]Time remaining until the end of the round is now always displayed.[/*]  [*]Added a smoke effect when entering invisibility.[/*]  [*]Adjusted various graphic settings, including the addition of motion blur.[/*]  [*]Added air control while moving in the air.[/*]  [*]Made it impossible to transition into sliding from running.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 0.2.1: Movement Gods Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]NEW FEATURES[/h2][list]  [*][b]ForceStart Command:[/b] Added the ability to force-start the first round via a console command, even if there aren't enough players on the server. To use it, open the console with the "~" key (ensure your keyboard layout is set to English) and enter the command "ForceStart".[/*]  [*][b]Automatic Reload:[/b] By popular demand, automatic reload has been added.[/*]  [*][b]Game Time Display:[/b] The Tab key now shows the time remaining in the current stage instead of total game time.[/*]  [*][b]Endgame Display:[/b] The end of the game now shows the winner and the time remaining until the restart.[/*][/list][h2]BUG FIXES[/h2][list]  [*][b]Reload Bug:[/b] Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented reloading.[/*]  [*][b]Spectator Mode:[/b] Players joining mid-game will now be spectators instead of taking over an existing player's spot.[/*]  [*][b]Restart Crash:[/b] Fixed a crash that occurred during game restart.[/*]  [*][b]Turret Destruction:[/b] Turrets are no longer destroyed at the start of the first-round preparation stage.[/*]  [*][b]Host Crash:[/b] Fixed a crash that occurred when the host killed the last enemy with an Uzi.[/*]  [*][b]Round Transition:[/b] Fixed an issue where rounds would incorrectly end and transition to the preparation stage due to a faulty timer.[/*]  [*][b]UI Bug:[/b] Fixed a bug where one player would not have a UI after dying last.[/*]  [*][b]Portal Sound:[/b] Reduced the volume of portal sounds.[/*]  [*][b]Box Map Katana Crash:[/b] Removed the katana from the Box map to prevent crashes.[/*]  [*][b]Volume Settings:[/b] Fixed an issue where volume settings did not affect kunai sounds.[/*]  [*][b]Death Knockback:[/b] Increased knockback on character death.[/*]  [*][b]Box Map Item Spawners:[/b] Removed item spawners from the Box map.[/*]  [*][b]Arena Map Sniper Spawner:[/b] Added a sniper rifle spawner to the center of the Arena map.[/*][/list][h2]BALANCE CHANGES[/h2]
Changes were made to improve the playability of weaker weapons and adjust stronger ones. Additionally, the reward system has been revised.
[list]  [*][b]Starting Funds:[/b] Reduced starting funds to 70. Earnings per round now increase by 20, resulting in round payouts of 70, 90, 110, 130, and 160, respectively.[/*]  [*][b]Item Purchases:[/b] The ability to purchase items using another player's funds has been temporarily removed.[/*]  [*][b]Explosive Pistol:[/b] Damage reduced from 50 to 35 (at the explosion center). Explosion radius reduced from 500 to 300. Fire delay increased from 0.14 to 0.22 seconds. Price increased from 80 to 90.[/*]  [*][b]Turret:[/b] Damage reduced from 24 to 20. Price increased from 50 to 70. Health reduced to 60.[/*]  [*][b]Sniper Rifle:[/b] Damage increased from 35 to 45. Price reduced from 80 to 60. Bullet speed increased from 35000.0 to 60000.0. Camera shake effect reduced by half.[/*]  [*][b]Rocket Launcher:[/b] Center explosion damage reduced from 70 to 55. Edge explosion damage reduced from 30 to 20.[/*]  [*][b]Uzi:[/b] Damage reduced from 9 to 8. Price reduced to 50. Recoil reduced by half. Camera shake effect reduced by half.[/*]  [*][b]Pistol:[/b] Price reduced to 40. Camera shake effect reduced by half.[/*]  [*][b]Rifle:[/b] Price reduced from 70 to 50. Bullet speed increased from 28000 to 50000. Total spread reduced by half. Camera shake effect reduced by 2/5.[/*]  [*][b]Invisibility:[/b] Price reduced to 40. Duration increased to 12 seconds.[/*][/list]

tags.feature: [b]ForceStart Command:[/b] Added the ability to force-start the first round via a console command, even if there aren't enough players on the server. To use it, open the console with the "~" key (ensure your keyboard layout is set to English) and enter the command "ForceStart".
[b]Automatic Reload:[/b] By popular demand, automatic reload has been added.
[b]Game Time Display:[/b] The Tab key now shows the time remaining in the current stage instead of total game time.
[b]Endgame Display:[/b] The end of the game now shows the winner and the time remaining until the restart.

tags.bug: [b]Reload Bug:[/b] Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented reloading.
[b]Spectator Mode:[/b] Players joining mid-game will now be spectators instead of taking over an existing player's spot.
[b]Restart Crash:[/b] Fixed a crash that occurred during game restart.
[b]Turret Destruction:[/b] Turrets are no longer destroyed at the start of the first-round preparation stage.
[b]Host Crash:[/b] Fixed a crash that occurred when the host killed the last enemy with an Uzi.
[b]Round Transition:[/b] Fixed an issue where rounds would incorrectly end and transition to the preparation stage due to a faulty timer.
[b]UI Bug:[/b] Fixed a bug where one player would not have a UI after dying last.

tags.balance_change: [b]Portal Sound:[/b] Reduced the volume of portal sounds.

tags.bug: [b]Box Map Katana Crash:[/b] Removed the katana from the Box map to prevent crashes.
[b]Volume Settings:[/b] Fixed an issue where volume settings did not affect kunai sounds.

tags.balance_change: [b]Death Knockback:[/b] Increased knockback on character death.

tags.bug: [b]Box Map Item Spawners:[/b] Removed item spawners from the Box map.

tags.feature: [b]Arena Map Sniper Spawner:[/b] Added a sniper rifle spawner to the center of the Arena map.

tags.balance_change: [b]Starting Funds:[/b] Reduced starting funds to 70. Earnings per round now increase by 20, resulting in round payouts of 70, 90, 110, 130, and 160, respectively.
[b]Item Purchases:[/b] The ability to purchase items using another player's funds has been temporarily removed.

[b]Explosive Pistol:[/b] Damage reduced from 50 to 35 (at the explosion center). Explosion radius reduced from 500 to 300. Fire delay increased from 0.14 to 0.22 seconds. Price increased from 80 to 90.
[b]Turret:[/b] Damage reduced from 24 to 20. Price increased from 50 to 70. Health reduced to 60.
[b]Sniper Rifle:[/b] Damage increased from 35 to 45. Price reduced from 80 to 60. Bullet speed increased from 35000.0 to 60000.0. Camera shake effect reduced by half.
[b]Rocket Launcher:[/b] Center explosion damage reduced from 70 to 55. Edge explosion damage reduced from 30 to 20.
[b]Uzi:[/b] Damage reduced from 9 to 8. Price reduced to 50. Recoil reduced by half. Camera shake effect reduced by half.
[b]Pistol:[/b] Price reduced to 40. Camera shake effect reduced by half.
[b]Rifle:[/b] Price reduced from 70 to 50. Bullet speed increased from 28000 to 50000. Total spread reduced by half. Camera shake effect reduced by 2/5.
[b]Invisibility:[/b] Price reduced to 40. Duration increased to 12 seconds.

notes.title: Major Update: Movement Gods 0.2.0
notes.content: [list]  [*]Completely redesigned the main menu interface.[/*]  [*]Revamped the in-game HUD.[/*]  [*]Introduced a new game mode:    [list]      [*]Purchase equipment during the preparation phase using a special terminal.[/*]      [*]Use the equipment to eliminate enemies and earn currency.[/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]Added an abilities system, activated with the X button:    [list]      [*]Current abilities include invisibility and turret deployment.[/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]Fixed numerous minor bugs and crash-causing issues.[/*]  [*]Resolved a bug where players respawned as spectators at the center of the map (including underground) after death.[/*][/list]

tags.feature: Completely redesigned the main menu interface.
Revamped the in-game HUD.
Introduced a new game mode:
Purchase equipment during the preparation phase using a special terminal.
Use the equipment to eliminate enemies and earn currency.
Added an abilities system, activated with the X button:
Current abilities include invisibility and turret deployment.

tags.bug: Fixed numerous minor bugs and crash-causing issues.
Resolved a bug where players respawned as spectators at the center of the map (including underground) after death.
